reviews.author: chris simmons
reviews.text: Great customer service. Knowledgeable mechanic who offers you the right advice at a more than reasonable price!! Great work. Charged half of what the dealer charges but better work. Highly recommend!!! Gave me a fair deal on a clutch job I unfortunately couldn't do myself due to injury. Didn't know I was a mechanic and didn't try to oversell anything.

reviews.author: Richard Robinson
reviews.text: Ok. I'm constantly asked to review things yet rarely do I read the reviews. I've obviously been having my vehicles repaired at Joe's for a while. I've never asked him to paint my vehicle as he is a mechanic. He seems to be doing as well as he wants to be doing, so I refrain from offering advice about how to run his garage, again, he's the mechanic, not to mention, it's his garage. Good mechanics fix automobiles. Capable mechanics are in possession of 24 valuable hours each day. Sometimes you have to pay just to find out what the problem is. Diagnostics aren't free nor are they guaranteed to solve every problem the first time. Any doubts or concerns? The dealership probably has plenty of room and certificates. I'd bet they stick to the hours stuck on the door. Feel free to pay them. I just like for my vehicle to get me from point a to point b. Joe is a good guy to know if that is your intent. He also has business cards and a cellphone he answers.

reviews.author: Richard Robinson
reviews.text: I have a 97 F-150 and have taken it to Joe’s every time it has an issue, which is fairly often with 20 year old trucks. His rates are always reasonable, his work is high quality and he gets the job done promptly. Honest, hardworking people are rare in this line of work. I’m glad to have found Joe

reviews.author: Erick Bennett
reviews.text: Joe is a great guy with a wonderful personality, but I received my vehicle back from him after a week with one of the worst paint jobs I’ve ever seen. Overspray everywhere inside the car and all over the windows/trim aswell as a lot of visible “orange peel” I chose to go to him because he seemed very experienced and professional, but I wish I just went to maaco at the end of the day

reviews.author: Kaleb Ward
reviews.text: Great shop. Joe got my Chevy back on the road same day for a very fair price. 10/10 would recommend this place.

reviews.author: James Evans
reviews.text: Expensive, but good fair price. He will work with you in your situation. Even if you tell him a dumb joke he will laugh with you.
